title: Coarse+
description: This mod adds coarse vairants for; Sand, Red Sand & Gravel.
body:
## A small mod that adds variants of coarse blocks: ### Sand Crafted via two Gravel & two Sand.
Can be Tilled with a Hoe to give Sand. ![Coarse Sand & Sand Checkerboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/defad567ea4a60dbaa055f0297d4413612c608fa.png) ### Red Sand Crafted via two Gravel & two Red Sand.
Can be Tilled with a Hoe to give Red Sand. ![Coarse Red Sand & Red Sand Checkerboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50198c8dc94003c9209d19e963fb6972dfbe6f06.png) ### Gravel Crafted via two Cobblestone & two Gravel.
Can be Tilled with a Hoe to give Gravel. ![Coarse Gravel & Gravel Checkerboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76c8b31a503c47863092b65dc55492f3a5c3c720.png)
